from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from llm_router._api.errors import ConfigurationError
from llm_router._api.types import Model, Provider
from llm_router._internal.config import (
    BehaviorDefaults,
    LLMRouterConfig,
    ProviderCatalog,
    ProviderLimits,
    RetryPolicy,
    RouterPolicyDefaults,
)
from llm_router._internal.runtime.routes import _resolve_model

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


def _build_config_declaring_only_flash_lite() -> LLMRouterConfig:
    provider_limits = ProviderLimits(
        rps=1.0,
        rpm=60.0,
        cooldown_seconds=1.0,
        cooldown_after_failures=3,
    )
    policy = RouterPolicyDefaults(
        max_attempts=3,
        attempt_timeout_seconds=30.0,
        wait_for_cooldown_if_all_blocked=False,
        round_robin_start=False,
        shuffle_fallbacks=False,
        min_routes_for_fallback_shuffle=2,
        default_limits=provider_limits,
    )
    defaults = BehaviorDefaults(
        retry_policy=RetryPolicy(
            min_wait_seconds=0.1, max_wait_seconds=1.0, max_attempts=3
        ),
        policy=policy,
        default_max_tool_rounds=4,
        structured_output_max_attempts=2,
        provider_limits=provider_limits,
    )
    catalog = ProviderCatalog(
        models={Model.GEMINI_FLASH_LITE: {Provider.GOOGLE: "gemini-flash-lite"}},
    )
    return LLMRouterConfig(
        default_provider=Provider.GOOGLE,
        default_model=Model.GEMINI_FLASH_LITE,
        default_key_id=1,
        defaults=defaults,
        catalog=catalog,
    )


@pytest.mark.verifies("TREQ_CONFIG_MODEL_DECLARATION[revision==1]")
def test_declared_string_model_resolves_to_declared_enum_member() -> None:
    config = _build_config_declaring_only_flash_lite()

    resolved = _resolve_model(Model.GEMINI_FLASH_LITE.value, config=config)

    assert isinstance(resolved, Model)
    assert resolved is Model.GEMINI_FLASH_LITE


@pytest.mark.verifies("TREQ_CONFIG_MODEL_DECLARATION[revision==1]")
def test_undeclared_string_model_is_rejected_before_provider_execution() -> None:
    config = _build_config_declaring_only_flash_lite()

    with pytest.raises(
        ConfigurationError, match=rf"Unknown model: {Model.GEMINI_PRO.value}"
    ):
        _resolve_model(Model.GEMINI_PRO.value, config=config)
